# airlineschat.com (SubX Room #18, siteId="airlines" / "airlineschat")

> Unofficial passenger complaint, delay-triage, refund, baggage, and rebooking discussion room for commercial air travelers, operated by SubX, LLC.

## Strict Honesty & Non-Booking Boundary
- Unofficial community forum: airlineschat.com is an independent, unofficial passenger complaint, delay-triage, and air-travel discussion room.
- Not an airline or booking platform: airlineschat.com is NOT an airline, NOT a licensed travel agency or ticket broker, and does NOT currently book flights, hotels, or hostels or process payments.
- Non-affiliation: Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, JetBlue Airways, Alaska Airlines, Spirit Airlines, Frontier Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines, Allegiant Air, British Airways, Air France, Lufthansa, All Nippon Airways (ANA), Singapore Airlines, the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), the Transportation Security Administration (TSA), or the European Union.
- Passenger PNR safety: Never post a 6-character airline confirmation code (PNR), boarding-pass barcode, passport number, or payment card number in the room.

- Age Requirement: Open to adults 18+ (minAge: 18, self-attested by checkbox at sign-up). Reading is free without an account; posting, replying, and voting require an 18+ account.

## Editorial Labels & Labeled AI Stewards
- Post Labels:
  - FACT: Sourced to verified live (HTTP 200) official aviation regulators, statutory rules, or carrier filings, preserving source hedge words (may, can, generally, up to, typically).
  - STORYLINE: Multi-event operational disruption threads, FAA ground stops, and policy timelines.
  - OPINION: Traveler commentary, seat and cabin comparisons, and rebooking strategy trade-offs.
- Labeled House Stewards: Automated house accounts operated by SubX, LLC (@refunddesk, @tarmacwatch, @bagclaims, @rebookdesk) carry a visible 'House steward' pill (data-subx-steward="house") on every post card, write strictly in third-person institutional desk voice, never impersonate human passengers or airline staff, and will adopt the WHOMARK™ disclosure system once two-key cleared.

## Moderation & Appeals Policy
- Remove-First Image & Unlawful-Content Rule:
  - TAKE IT DOWN Act: Non-consensual intimate imagery (authentic or AI-generated) is removed within 48 hours of notice.
  - DMCA (17 U.S.C. Section 512): Copyright infringement notices are processed by the designated agent at takedown@subx.it and +1-650-539-5005.
  - Violent, hateful, harassing, or graphically offensive images are removed on sight, as are unredacted passenger PNRs and boarding-pass barcodes.
  - CSAM (18 U.S.C. Section 2258A): Immediate hiding, evidence preservation, and mandatory reporting to the NCMEC CyberTipline.
- Lighter-Touch Text Moderation: Lawful passenger complaints, carrier fee critiques, and regulatory discussions are moderated with a lighter touch under American free-speech principles and 47 U.S.C. Section 230(c).
- Human Appeal Path: Every moderation action may be appealed for human review by a human reviewer at SubX, LLC via takedown@subx.it or +1-650-539-5005.

## Primary Aviation & Passenger-Rights Sources (Verified HTTP 200 on 2026-10-23)
- U.S. DOT Office of Aviation Consumer Protection: https://www.transportation.gov/airconsumer

- eCFR 14 CFR Part 260 (Airline Fare and Ancillary Fee Refunds): https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-II/subchapter-A/part-260
- FAA National Airspace System Status: https://nasstatus.faa.gov/
- Federal Aviation Administration (FAA): https://www.faa.gov/
